title: Puig’s fragrance and make-up brands drive record Q3 revenue of €1.4 billion
summary: All of Puig’s business divisions and regions saw revenue growth, with a double-digit increase in niche fragrances, dermocosmetics, make-up and the Asia-Pacific region
